measurement_limits: The targeted regression set does not replace the full Environment suite.
The tests establish the bounded recorded state and projection behavior, not a reduction in intervention burden or a systemwide service fulfillment ratio.
Rejected checkpoints leave campaign state unchanged; their operation diagnostics are not persisted in this summary.

verified_properties: A selected readable observation reference is recorded as validated with exact candidate and validated counts.
A candidate with no selected Environment checkout is recorded as not-evaluated with its reason and no added checkout authority.
A checkpoint adding no matching observations is recorded as not-applicable.
A malformed selected record is rejected before publication and leaves prior campaign state unchanged.
Campaign-state reads and full and compact ECI projections retain the bounded result.
